name: Sapan Verma | Indian Film Festival Melbourne 2025 | Opening Monologue
description: hi guys, last month I got a chance to host the awards night of Indian Film Festival Melbourne in Australia. The guests included Aamir Khan, Abhishek Bachchan, Aditi Rao Hyadri, Jaideep Ahlawat, Malaika Arora, Shoojit Sircar, Arvind Swamy, Vikramaditya Motwane and a bunch of other film industry folks
